His only wish is to govern peacefully and make an honest living, with no desire to get involved in court conflicts. Yet, fate keeps crossing his path with the royal family. Using his advanced knowledge of science and engineering, he revitalizes local industries, improves people's livelihoods, builds military weapons, and protects his county. While safeguarding his land, he navigates political schemes and powerful factions, defusing crisis after crisis. Along the way, he forms deep bonds with those around him. overview: In the immortal realm of Sanshan Liuxian, the High God Qingxuan stands as the guardian of the Heavenly Dao, wielding the divine sword *Hong*—forged from the spiritual scales of the Tengshe serpent and the legendary Sky-Mending Stone. As the keeper of the celestial order of ascension, he oversees all cultivators seeking immortality. To ascend to the Nine Heavens, one must first pass through his judgment and sever every worldly attachment, desire, and emotional bond. Everything changes when a plum blossom demoness arrives to undergo her ascension. Though her cultivation has reached perfection, she refuses to relinquish her love for Qingxuan and the vow she made to her sisters, declaring that she would rather abandon immortality than extinguish the fire in her heart. Moved by her conviction, Qingxuan is shaken. For the first time, he gazes upon *Hong*, the sword that has severed countless ties of love and longing, only to find his own long-buried emotions reflected within its blade. The Heavenly Dao is said to be without mercy, yet unwavering faith can sometimes inspire an exception. Determined to seek the true path of cultivation, Qingxuan voluntarily descends to the mortal world. Forgoing reincarnation, he carries the Fox Clan's Spirit-Concentrating Pearl and is reborn in Qingqiu. After five hundred years of arduous cultivation in the form of a fox, he finally attains human form. Thereafter, bearing a medicine chest on his back and a sword at his side, he journeys across the mortal realm. Slaying demons, dispelling evil, healing the sick, and aiding those in need, he wanders through the countless joys and sorrows of ordinary life. Amid the vibrant tapestry of human existence, Qingxuan embarks on a new quest—not for ascension, but to discover the true essence of the Dao.

overview: Cang Yue is unexpectedly transported into a video game and learns that the only way to return to the real world is to complete the story's assigned missions. Inside the game, she becomes the last surviving descendant of the Moonshade Clan, whose main quest is to uncover the truth behind her clan's massacre and seek justice for its destruction. To investigate, Cang Yue infiltrates the royal court of Donglin and meets Jing Yuan, a seemingly ordinary eunuch. Believing Emperor Si Xingxuan to be responsible for her clan's downfall, she initially targets him as the object of her revenge. As the story unfolds, however, she discovers that Si Xingxuan is merely a puppet controlled by the Grand Princess, Si Xinglan, and that the extermination of the Moonshade Clan was a conspiracy orchestrated by Si Xinglan herself. Joining forces with Si Xingxuan and Jing Yuan, Cang Yue uncovers the truth behind the tragedy and ultimately brings Si Xinglan to justice. After completing the game's central quest and fulfilling her mission of revenge, she successfully returns to the real world.

overview: In September 1845, a devastating new plant disease swept across Ireland, destroying the potato crops on which the majority of the people depended. Over the subsequent six years, a million Irish people died of starvation and a more than a million others fled abroad in order to escape the ravages of hunger and disease.

overview: A Queens homeowner is arrested trying to enter her own house. A con artist loots a missing millionaire's estate. A grieving family watches a stranger wear their dead mother's clothes and then gets sued for $400,000 by the squatter from prison. And a New Jersey homeowner has a jaw-dropping showdown involving the S.W.A.T. Team. In Squatters: Get the F*** Out of My House, the new docuseries from executive producers Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos, families are forced into shocking and emotional battles against squatters exploiting legal loopholes to live rent-free in homes they don't own. The six-part series follows ordinary people blindsided by manipulators who know exactly how to weaponize tenant protections and turn the legal system against the very people it's supposed to protect. From Queens to Malibu to Newark, each case is more infuriating than the last — and the system keeps failing the people who hold the deed.
